status_desc.VALID: Deed payload and ledger hash chain are authentic and mathematically valid.
status_desc.TAMPERED: Discrepancy detected in deed payload, SHA-256 hash, or digital signature. High risk of forgery.
status_desc.SUPERSEDED: A subsequent active deed has been registered on this plot. Does not reflect current ownership.
status_desc.CANCELLED: This deed has been formally cancelled due to mutation rejection or authorized administrative order.
status_desc.UNKNOWN: No record or digital signature found in the system for this deed number.

hero.title: Independent Cryptographic Verification for Bangladesh Land Records
hero.subtitle: Stop land disputes and double-selling before closing. Powered by Ed25519 digital signatures, immutable SHA-256 hash chains, and explainable AI fraud detection.
hero.cta_check_desc: Inspect plot risk score, ownership chain, and legal flags by Mouza & Dag number
hero.cta_verify_desc: Instant verification of digital signature, hash integrity, and ledger status
hero.cta_login_desc: Secure workspace for Sub-Registrars and AC Land Officers
hero.pillar1_desc: Every deed is digitally signed with the Sub-Registrar's secret key. Any alteration breaks the mathematical proof in milliseconds.
hero.pillar2_desc: Per-plot SHA-256 blockchain-style chaining prevents retroactive deletion, reordering, or covert insertion of history.
hero.pillar3_desc: Pre-registration blocks double sales, impossible overselling, stranger sellers, and unregistered transfers automatically.
